crates/table-ledger/src/groups.rs:178 Owner-defined groups are rows in fixed tables, not operator-defined physical tables requiring migration-time enumeration.

crates/table-ledger/src/lib.rs:136 SQLite provides an atomic home for the version marker inside the transaction containing the schema changes; no independent external shape-writing mechanism was found.

crates/table-ledger/src/lib.rs:75 One transaction surrounds every pending migration, followed by one final version bump and commit; the standard requires a transaction and ledger advance per step.
